verdict.rationale: Factory documents assigning a Linear or Jira issue to Factory, or mentioning @Factory in an issue comment, so that Droid investigates, implements, and tests the work. That directly delivers assigning a coding task to an agent from an existing ticket. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the issue-delegation flow, and documented coverage of other issue trackers beyond Linear and Jira.

support.subject: As a developer, I can assign a coding task to an agent directly from an existing issue or ticket
